label: Sfx: Lightkeeper's raise, gong, tink and fold arms, before the shared rune-crack fallback
why: The four voices (v77 s5), in the synth only. The arms are added BEFORE the shared rune-crack fallback, and the fallback line is re-emitted unchanged, so the 11 other relics that still fall through keep it and another relic's row anchored there applies in either order. Through the patched play() every arm reproduces its lab candidate (worst 9e-08; the tink at k -1..6 and none, on two noise draws), 131 other voices are unchanged (worst 2e-07), and ult/lightkeeper is no longer rune-crack. play() returns on its first line with no audio context (every headless run), draws no random number and writes nothing the simulation reads; end to end the four voices through the patched page's own SFX.play equal the candidates (worst 1e-07).
